title: Peshawar Board Publishes List for Free Chromebooks
excerpt: BISE Peshawar has released the official list of Class 9 students eligible for the free Chromebook distribution program.
body_html:
The Board of Intermediate and Secondary Education (BISE) Peshawar has officially published the roster of Class 9 students selected to receive free Chromebooks.

The release marks a step forward in the distribution process for the devices. Eligible students and their families can now check the newly released list to confirm their status.
